Items.Description: acme-xml 1.4.2 resolves external entities when it parses XML documents. An attacker who controls an uploaded statement file can read files from the server (XXE).
Items.FixRecommendation: Upgrade com.acme.libs:acme-xml to version 2.0.0 or later.

Items.Description: The session cookie is created without the Secure attribute and can be sent over plain HTTP.
Items.FixRecommendation: Call setSecure(true) on the session cookie.

Items.Description: User input is written to the audit log without neutralizing line breaks.
Items.FixRecommendation: Encode CR and LF characters before logging user input.
